authorization: Restore the prior defaults now. Replace strategy/risk only after demonstrated material improvement. Engineering changes do not authorize private account actions.

adoption.return_route: cost-net CNY CAGR >= baseline*1.10 with continuous proxy MDD <= baseline; calibrated actual beta/volatility controls and stressed/cross-era evidence required
adoption.risk_route: cost-net CNY CAGR >= baseline*.95 with continuous proxy MDD <= baseline*.80; compare with simply reduced risk budget
adoption.comparison: Same real independently funded wallet capital, costs, FX, actual manual-session schedule, initial state and valuation convention. No curve scaling or fresh-cold Spot cash comparison as continuous incumbent.
adoption.phase_gate: positive total returns or software/audit passes alone cannot admit a default
adoption.stress: Registered doubled fee/slippage screen; actual incumbent stress cases reused when applicable; advantage must survive stress and not depend on a single era
adoption.qualification: Magnitude threshold is necessary, not sufficient. Historical development improvement is not prospective alpha or native qualification.
adoption.goals: Original Spot100%/MDD<=30%, Coin150%/MDD<50% unchanged; never describe them as met absent matching evidence.

absorption.mechanism: completed 4h OI contraction>=5%, sell liquidation/turnover>=1%, signed spot BTC flow imbalance>=10%; seven-day event outcome from first actual manual execution opportunity
absorption.controls: BTC return, completed momentum/RMS, incumbent SX60/DFII10; >=10 non-overlapping mature events, chronological halves>=3 each, control-adjusted net effect positive in both halves including doubled costs
absorption.failure: If information has no incremental edge, close it. Only documented same-clock execution loss can admit a different execution expression. Do not move sessions or tune thresholds.
absorption.current: qualified OI/forced-flow/spot-absorption event receipts absent; old OI pending results reused

option-risk.mechanism: near30day actual signed near25delta greeks; average put/call IV>=1.25*causal20day realized RMS and putIV>callIV; candidate only halves NEW risk commitments, never changes held owners
option-risk.controls: >=10 non-overlapping mature seven-day outcomes and chronological halves>=3 each; tail forecast incremental to realized RMS; actual lost profits and tail loss versus uniform half-budget control
option-risk.failure: No incremental tail forecast: close. Valid information but poor action economics: require a distinct preregistered use; do not rename rejected ATR/drawdown budgets.
option-risk.current: one actual receipt day and no mature seven-day information evidence; not a new historical sample

expiry-basis.mechanism: BTC USDT-settled linear dated contract short plus independently funded spot long; executable-size spot ask/futures bid<=250ms apart and<=1s old; explicit roundtrip fees/financing/slip/settlement basis reserves and >=30% upward collateral stress
expiry-basis.controls: positive net income with doubled fees and reserves before writing any execution adapter; confirmed contract settlement and joint margin/hedge path needed before account entry
expiry-basis.failure: Negative executable net basis closes mechanism. Missing executable contract/books remains pending. Do not replace missing quotes with daily closes or assumed maker fills.
expiry-basis.current: no qualified dated contract and executable two-leg USDT book receipts; inverse/USDC quotes cannot substitute

measurement: Use existing failures and immutable receipts. Information screening first; one actual entrant per project only after mature support; no new795 for rollback/source identity/docs. Repeatedly used history remains development data.
rollback: The target-core default is retired now. Preserve all negative evidence, no forced Git rewriting or state migration. Any future failed candidate stays outside default.
budget: No large-vault scan, no new accounts without entrant, no account actions. One final full software run per repository; scope-only failure repair.
